context: A senior mentors a junior on the business
purpose: Mentor on business; teach 株主/合理/各種/流通/廃止/命令/要請/中間

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 会社の仕組み、少しずつ分かってきた？
lines.en: Are you grasping the company’s workings?
lines.style: mentoring manager checking in, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。株主の存在の大きさを実感しました。
lines.en: Yes. I felt how big the shareholders’ presence is.
lines.style: learning junior reflecting, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 合理的に動くのが、ビジネスの基本だよ。
lines.en: Acting rationally is the basics of business.
lines.style: mentor sharing a principle, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各種の調整が、こんなに大変だとは。
lines.en: I didn’t expect all the coordination to be so hard.
lines.style: humbled junior admitting it, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 流通や在庫の管理も、奥が深い。
lines.en: Distribution and inventory management run deep too.
lines.style: mentor widening her view, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 古い慣習の廃止も、勇気が要りますね。
lines.en: Abolishing old customs takes courage too.
lines.style: junior reflecting thoughtfully, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 上の命令を、ただ待つだけじゃだめだ。
lines.en: Just waiting for top orders isn’t enough.
lines.style: mentor pushing initiative, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 自分から要請する姿勢も大事ですね。
lines.style: junior internalizing the lesson, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう。中間にいる僕らが、橋渡しをするんだ。
lines.en: Right. We in the middle do the bridging.
lines.style: mentor framing their role, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
